propositions: The verifier budget exhausts on legitimate validation of multi-criterion tickets (especially epics), misclassifying valid but unproven criteria as unmet.

Budget floor and per-criterion defaults (8 steps/48 min) are calibrated to story-level costs and do not scale with epic child traversal overhead (5-10 requests per child), forcing re-verification cycles every ~10 minutes.
Every re-verify re-proves all criteria from scratch with no cross-run caching, creating redundant work even when prior runs produced valid PASS verdicts.
The current clamp (480 steps) and small budget add no runaway safety benefit (already separately guarded by tool_calls_limit and loop detection) but artificially fail valid validations.
Criteria cached as PASS across runs with a scoped fingerprint (file_impact blob SHAs and criterion text) and seeded into the run bank must not be downgraded by finalizer judgment on re-verify.
